The first public version of **Umbral World**, a dark, gothic-horror dimension for Minecraft Java 26.3.

> **Alpha.** Early version: expect bugs and balance changes, and back up worlds you care about.

## Requirements
- Minecraft Java Edition **26.3**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.19.5** or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3

## Install
Download **`umbral-world-0.1.0.jar`** below and put it, together with Fabric API, in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.

## Getting there
- **Portal:** a Nether-portal-shaped frame of Shadestone blocks. It opens by itself in the dark (light level 4 or below), so build it at night or underground.
- **The void:** falling out of the bottom of the Overworld or the End drops you into the Umbral World instead of killing you. (Heads-up: this includes falling off the End's islands.)
- Shadestone Ore is found deep in the Overworld, near bedrock.

## What's in 0.1.0
- Three biomes: the **Grave**, the **Miasma** and the **Chasm**, under twin black suns
- Creatures that fade from sight in the light: the Wight, the Ghoul, the Crawler, the Cursed Soul, the Murkfiend and the Chasm Skate
- The Shadestone Blade (Deep Blindness), the Dark Furnace (smelts with darkness), Corpse Candles, the Wight's Shroud, Ectoplasm and the Potion of the Nightstalker, Cinderite ore

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/TheDarkHorse99/Shadestone-Mod/issues) with your Minecraft, Fabric Loader and Fabric API versions and the crash report or log.
